description: This file defines Express routes for managing 'links' in a web application, including CRUD operations, analytics, and click tracking, with external dependencies on models and validation utilities.

methods.name: GET /links
methods.description: Retrieves a list of links for the authenticated user with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: POST /links
methods.description: Creates a new link for the authenticated user.

methods.name: PATCH /links/:id
methods.description: Updates a specific link owned by the authenticated user.

methods.name: DELETE /links/:id
methods.description: Deletes a specific link owned by the authenticated user.

methods.name: GET /links/analytics/summary
methods.description: Returns summary analytics (total links and clicks) for the authenticated user.

methods.name: POST /links/:id/click
methods.description: Public endpoint that increments the click count for a link.

methods.name: GET /links/:id
methods.description: Fetches a single link, with access controlled by RLS policies and ownership.
